name: Tobias
source:
Tobias is a young hunter who lives in the forest, secluded from the rest of the village. He was the one who found Lena after she got injured and separated from her group, and despite her thankfulness for his kind deed, getting along with him is no easy task.

Tobias prefers the company of himself instead of others. He expresses a huge dislike towards the war occurring in the "outside world" and anything related to it. As a result, he finds it difficult to accept the presence of someone like Lena.

While still capable, Tobias pales in comparison with Simon, Lena, and Gavin when it comes to combat.

[from [url=http://hinoyabu.wordpress.com/2013/08/22/blue-rose-characters-tobias/]Creator's blog[/url]]
